ac_M6_1_arbitration.option_1_rationale: The hook's primary value is preventing huge functions and deep nesting (high cognitive load). File-level line count is the weakest signal — a 1000-line file with 30 small clean functions is fine; a 200-line file with one 100-line function is bad. The user's original motivating example for M6 was unblocking `logger.info` instrumentation in `AgentInput.tsx` (1393-line legacy file per BA spec line 101). Symmetric file_lines defeats this. Option 1 preserves the actual quality intent (no function or nesting regression) while honoring the legacy-instrumentation use case.
